description: This file implements the ModuleComparer class, which compares modules in the breakpad crash reporting system, including serialization, deserialization, and deep comparison of module components.

classes.name: ModuleComparer
classes.description: A class that provides methods to compare and verify the equality of module data structures within the breakpad system.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Main method to compare symbol data by loading into modules, serializing, and comparing modules.

methods.name: CompareModule
methods.description: Deeply compares two modules' components for equality.

methods.name: CompareFunction
methods.description: Compares two function objects for equality.

methods.name: CompareLine
methods.description: Compares two line number entries for equality.

methods.name: ComparePubSymbol
methods.description: Compares two public symbol entries for equality.

methods.name: CompareWFI
methods.description: Compares two Windows Frame Information structures for equality.

methods.name: CompareCRM
methods.description: Recursively compares contained range maps for equality.
